rule.title: Loan principal is not interest: only the interest is deducted

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this item a repayment of loan principal (rather than interest)?

citation.wording: You can’t simply deduct your mortgage or principal payments, or the cost of furniture, fixtures, and equipment, as an expense.

rule.open_point: The cited sentence is Publication 527's, about rental property. For Schedule C the same rule is Publication 535 (2022 revision, the in-force continuous-use copy): "the payments are applied, in general, first to interest and any remainder to principal. You can deduct only the interest." An item mixing principal and interest is not split here; the preparer enters the interest part.
